speaker: ELENA WOODLINE
description: Young adult female voice featuring a light, bright timbre that turns creaky and high-pitched under pressure. She speaks in a formal, standard dialect with a hesitant, stuttering pace that quickens into breathless panic or forced laughter when flustered. Beneath her protective and caring headmistress persona, her emotional baseline is deeply anxious and easily startled under official scrutiny. Delivery should swing between a strained, cheerful attempt at formal composure and a panicked, high-pitched flutter.
